title: fix: add Lykon brand logo
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds the missing Lykon brand mapping for DreamShaper.
- Adds a lightweight monochrome bear SVG matching Lykon’s public identity.
- Changes no model registry, pricing, routing, access, or runtime behavior.

Testing:
- `npx vitest run test/pricing-data.test.ts` — 28/28 passed.
- Enter TypeScript check passed.
- SVG rendered and visually inspected.

gist.headline: DreamShaper finds its bear
gist.blurb: DreamShaper’s model card now has its proper Lykon mark: a small monochrome bear, finally reunited with the model it represents.
gist.summary: Added the missing Lykon brand mapping and monochrome bear SVG so DreamShaper displays its correct provider logo in the model interface.
gist.impact: Users browsing DreamShaper now see Lykon’s recognizable bear identity alongside the model, with no changes to pricing, routing, or access.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy model-library shelf where Polli carefully hangs a tiny monochrome pixel bear emblem beside a DreamShaper card, making the provider identity visible. Include a few flowering code-plants and a softly glowing retro terminal to represent the model interface.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny curator beret, carefully placing a small monochrome bear emblem on a DreamShaper model card in a warm retro computer library; code-plants and tiny flowers bloom around a CRT terminal glowing prominently lime green (#ecf874). Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, dark purple (#110518) outlines, with subtle pixel-font text: 'DREAMSHAPER'. Nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
